01 / ABOUT
About me
A little about me and what I am working on.
WHO AM I
From a small-town student and OIer
to exploring robotics and embodied AI.
I studied physics, chemistry, and biology while enjoying history, politics, and geography. Now I study robotics at Tongji University and explore embodied AI and world models. I have used the Gunpowder name and avatar since 2020. I also have more than a dozen online identities, now brought together under the Hachile network.
University
Tongji University
Major
Guohao College Future Technology Class (Robotics)
Focus
Embodied AI, world models
Social
I run more than 100 online communities
Interests and goals INTERESTS
I enjoy history, current affairs, and human geography;
I sometimes play rhythm games, Paradox games, and io games;
I am also interested in military studies, urban planning, philosophy, rail transit, digital art, and composition.
